messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — tenant=nightingale, pool=cobalt-1 (dedicated). Symptom=funcall failures / JSON parse errors. Error rate jump to ~11% over last 5m. Paging oncall@redwood.
maria (oncall): oncall here, seeing traces. Errors are all coming from tool call path -> tool-proxy returned 502 + body 'invalid_json' or 'parse_timeout'.
sanjay (eng-runtime): digging into logs now. I see stack: `jsonparser: parse_error Unexpected token '>' at pos 412` across multiple requests. Also some requests show `parser_timeout` after 200ms.
hana (eng-sre): is this hitting a new parser runtime? Any recent rollouts to cobalt-1?
maria (oncall): Not that I can see in deploy history within the pool. Last runtime rollout was 2 days ago.
ellie-cs: Customer (Nightingale) just reported higher error rate for their internal tool calls. They said it started ~16:30 UTC and they're seeing client retries. No PII leak reported.
devin (runtime-lead): Could be schema drift on the customer's tool response or a new strictness introduced in our parser lib. We shipped parser v3.2.0 as part of a micro-update 48h ago — need to confirm if cobalt-1 is on that version.
sanjay (eng-runtime): quick grep shows cobalt-1 nodes running `runtime-parser=3.2.0`. Running a small repro against a failing request now.
sanjay (eng-runtime): repro payload (sanitized):
```json
{"tool": "nightingale-annotate", "args": {"prompt": "...", "meta": {"request_id": "abc-123"}, "options": {"mode": "fast"}}}
```
response from tool proxy: `{"result": "ok", "meta": "<html>...>"}` — our parser expects JSON but proxy sometimes returns HTML error page -> strict parser throws.
maria (oncall): that explains it — HTML slip-through causes parse_error. How many tenants hit? Looks mostly Nightingale traffic in cobalt-1 (tenant isolation seems intact).
hana (eng-sre): impact: ~12% of Nightingale's funcalls failing, spike correlated with a specific upstream tool endpoint that started returning a 200 + HTML error banner on some internal errors.
ellie-cs: Customer confirms they rolled a config change on their internal tool around 16:25 UTC that may alter error responses. They're trying to revert but asked if we can do immediate mitigation on our side.
devin (runtime-lead): Immediate mitigations: 1) Add a tolerant JSON fallback in the funcall path that attempts to strip HTML when content-type mismatches. 2) Route Nightingale away from parser v3.2.0 to parser v3.1.compat (less strict) in cobalt-1. 3) Temp rule: return controlled 202+body to caller to avoid client retries.
sanjay (eng-runtime): Plan: apply traffic rule (routing) ASAP as quickest mitigation. Command: `rzctl route override --tenant nightingale --pool cobalt-1 --parser-version v3.1-compat --reason "hotfix: tolerate HTML slip"`
hana (eng-sre): I'll approve and execute the route change. Also enabling extra logging for a 30m window.
ops-bot: Executing job 87421: route override requested by hana.
ops-bot: Job 87421 completed — routes updated on 4/4 nodes in cobalt-1.
maria (oncall): routing change in place. Monitoring error rate now.
sanjay (eng-runtime): started a quick patch branch `hotfix/nightingale-parser-tolerate` — will add a small tolerant parser wrapper + unit test. Expect a patch in ~25m. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/1129
ellie-cs: I'll tell the customer we applied a temporary routing mitigation and are working on a patch; ETA ~45m. Please flag any user-visible changes.
hana (eng-sre): immediate metrics: error rate dropped from 11% -> 1.2% in the last 3m after route override. Latency unchanged.
devin (runtime-lead): good — keep routing for now until we push the tolerant parser. Post-patch we'll roll traffic back to parser v3.2.0 after smoke tests.
maria (oncall): opening incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incident/INC-2026-nightingale-funcall-json-timeout
notes: Sev2, customer impact (Nightingale) partial functional degradation, tenant isolation maintained, no data exposure.
sanjay (eng-runtime): hotfix PR merged to staging and deploying canary to one node in cobalt-1. Deploy command: `rzctl deploy cobalt-1 --image runtime-parser-hotfix:sha-abc123 --canary 1`
ops-bot: Deploy job 87489 started.
ops-bot: Canary pod is healthy.
hana (eng-sre): canary logs look clean. Running synthetic funcall through patched parser — succeeds.
maria (oncall): canary looks good — schedule gradual rollout across nodes over 15m.
ellie-cs: Customer updated: they're seeing fewer failures. Thanks.
sanjay (eng-runtime): full rollout completed. Post-rollout metrics: error rate ~0.3% (noise). Will keep extra logging for 1h.
maria (oncall): handing off to sanjay for post-deploy monitoring and postmortem writeup. I'll remain reachable but returning to baseline duties.
sanjay (eng-runtime): taking handoff — I'll own the postmortem and the follow-up change to add content-type heuristics in parser.
ellie-cs: I'll file a customer follow-up note and schedule a joint RCA call with Nightingale for tomorrow.
maria (oncall): thanks team. Incident resolved for now — reopen if we see regression.
